description: This file defines a template class ParserType for parsing text streams with various states, as well as classes TextParser and PathParser for text and path parsing respectively. It includes external headers related to enumeration, key-value pairs, numbers, optionals, portability, and ranges, indicating its role in a larger parsing framework within the WPEFramework::Core namespace.

classes.name: ParserType
classes.description: A template class for parsing streams of text with customizable terminators and handlers, managing parsing states, buffer, and position.

classes.name: TextParser
classes.description: A class for parsing text fragments, providing methods to read text, numbers, enumerations, key-value pairs, and ranges, with support for skipping and validation.

classes.name: PathParser
classes.description: A class for parsing filesystem paths into drive, path, filename, basename, and extension components.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the parser state to initial conditions.

methods.name: Position
methods.description: Returns the current position in the stream.

methods.name: CollectWord
methods.description: Configures the parser to collect a word, optionally with a split character and case state.

methods.name: CollectLine
methods.description: Configures the parser to collect a line.

methods.name: FlushLine
methods.description: Sets the parser to flush the current line.

methods.name: PassThrough
methods.description: Configures the parser to pass through a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a stream of bytes into parser state, handling external pass-through, line flushing, whitespace skipping, and token parsing.

methods.name: ReadText
methods.description: Reads text from a fragment, considering delimiters.

methods.name: ReadText (TextParser)
methods.description: Reads text into a result, considering delimiters.

methods.name: Skip
methods.description: Skips a specified number of positions or characters.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Finds specified characters in the text.

methods.name: SkipLine
methods.description: Skips to the end of the current line.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the current text fragment against a comparison, case-sensitive or insensitive.

methods.name: ReadNumber
methods.description: Reads a number of a specified type from the text fragment.

methods.name: ReadEnumerate
methods.description: Reads an enumeration value from the text fragment.

methods.name: ReadKeyValuePair
methods.description: Reads a key-value pair from the text fragment, separated by a divider.

methods.name: ReadRange
methods.description: Reads a range of numbers from the text fragment.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a TextFragment into path components.
